code-runner.executorMap.c: cd "$(cygpath -u "$dir")" && gcc "$fileName" -o "$fileNameWithoutExt.exe" && timeout 15s ./$fileNameWithoutExt.exe < ./input.txt > ./output.txt; exitCode=$?; if [ $exitCode -eq 124 ]; then echo 'Time Limit Exceeded' > ./output.txt; fi
code-runner.executorMap.cpp: cd "$(cygpath -u "$dir")" && g++ "$fileName" -o "$fileNameWithoutExt.exe" && timeout 15s ./$fileNameWithoutExt.exe < ./input.txt > ./output.txt; exitCode=$?; if [ $exitCode -eq 124 ]; then echo 'Time Limit Exceeded' > ./output.txt; fi
